changes: Added Auth0 and Google quick-fill buttons on the Configuration tab (desktop GUI and browser extensions). Added automatic redirect capture (local HttpListener) alongside manual paste in the desktop GUI, matching the browser extension. The preset status box now shows the button's colour. Added browser extensions for Chrome, Edge and Firefox. Fixed the desktop discovery URL and issuer/iss comparison to tolerate a trailing slash (Auth0 etc. no longer 404 on a trailing slash). Accept HS256 id_tokens (symmetric; not validated against JWKS). Added an OAuth.tools (Curity demo) preset button. The Auth0/Google/OAuth.tools preset buttons switch to Manual paste automatically. version.json is now read by the app and shown in the window title.
